name: Measure
thesis: A contemporary reading instrument that pairs expressive serif headlines with the precision and breathing room of Swiss typesetting.
difference: Bodoni Moda headlines begin on the outer margin while Newsreader credits, images and reading text share an inset axis; warm chalk, olive ink, soft image corners and an unboxed baseline navigation keep the centered brief quiet.
tradeoff: The asymmetric measure makes the story distinctive but gives descriptive text less width; the session counter doubles as the end-session control and is less explicit than a labeled finish button.
lens: A contemporary Swiss type designer creating an analog reading instrument for iPhone.
